component.name: SMITH Soundboard
component.summary: Play audio clips and speak through a virtual microphone
Reproduza áudios e fale por um microfone virtual

description.p: A native Linux soundboard with an uncapped audio library, categories, hotkeys, recording and nondestructive trimming.
Mix audio clips with your voice through PipeWire/PulseAudio, with separate volume controls and original dynamics by default.
